title: The Question That Was Really a Story
youtube_title: The Question That Was Really a Story | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Jorie about a question that was really a story and needed both. Jorie wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
